title: Duelling Trios
summary: At Leslie and Eglinton on the edge of the West Don Valley, Auberge on the Park's three towers preside amidst the falling dusk. Just to the east, another trio — the One Crosstown towers — appear to loom more ominously over a darker valley, making for a half dozen darkly brooding sentinels in this moody image courtesy of a well placed drone over Toronto's expansive ravine system.

title: 50-Storey Tower Proposed near Sheppard-Yonge Station
summary: CentreCourt is proposing a 50-storey condominium tower on a compact site at the northwest corner of Yonge Street and Cameron Avenue in North York’s Lansing-Westgate neighbourhood. Designed by Arcadis, 4656 Yonge Street would rise south of Sheppard-Yonge station, offering access to both Yonge Line 1 and Sheppard Line 4.
